note: A mixin field's literal initializer changes, the mixin applied straight to Object. AOT copies the field into dart:mixin_deduplication's &Object&Counter, and a patch cannot replace that copy, so the patch is refused and names the copied field. The frozen reference tooling compares procedures only and calls this inert, so it is not a witness here.
rejectionReasons: this field's initializer or declaration changed; a patch replaces method bodies only, so the release keeps its own initial value
